opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search sorted by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip_type} on {depart_date}/{return_date}, then sort results by lowest price (optionally showing points).
steps: Type origin in 'From' and select suggestion
Type destination in 'To' and select suggestion
Optionally switch Roundtrip/One-way
Pick depart date (and return date if roundtrip)
Click 'Search flights' and 'Continue to flight results'
Open 'Sort & Filter', optionally select Points fare display
Change sort from 'Default' to price low-to-high
Click Apply and optionally open flight Details

instances.values: New York -> Miami, roundtrip 27-31, Points, sort Price by Core
New York -> Toronto, one-way 29th, sort Price (low to high)
New York (NYC) -> Aruba (AUA), roundtrip 1st - May 5 2023, sort Price (low to high)

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search United car rentals at {pickup_location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date}, with optional pay-with-miles and pickup/drop-off times.
steps: Click 'CAR' tab
Optionally check 'Book with miles'
Type pickup location and select suggestion
Open Pickup date picker and choose pickup and drop-off dates
Optionally set pickup and drop-off times
Click 'Find cars'

instances.values: Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 9-15 2023, default times

opportunities.name: Budget careers job opening search
opportunities.description: Search Budget job openings filtered by {country}, {team} and {time_type}, optionally opening a posting and applying.
steps: Click 'Careers' then 'Openings'
Open Country filter, search and select country
Open Team filter, search and select team
Open Time Type filter, search and select time type
Click 'Search by job title or keyword'
Optionally open a job posting and click 'APPLY NOW'

instances.values: United States of America, Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate and Apply Now
United States of America, Finance, Full time

opportunities.name: Retail product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retailer for {keyword}, cap results at {max_price}, and add a matching product to the cart.
steps: Type keyword in the site search box and submit
Enter maximum price in the price filter and click Go
Optionally open a product
Click 'Add to Cart'

instances.values: Amazon: 'wireless headphones', max $100, EAORUL ANC headphones

opportunities.name: NPS find park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, find parks matching selected {activity} or {topic} options.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK'
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Expand 'Activity' or 'Topic'
Check the desired option checkboxes
Click 'Search'

opportunities.name: MTA bridge and tunnel toll lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Look up MTA Bridges & Tunnels toll rates for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Go to Fares & Tolls (or Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels)
Open the Bridges and Tunnels tolls / toll rates section
Select the vehicle type tab
Expand the relevant crossing group
